text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since
Dantsu Flame and I signed our trainer
contract—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While deliberating when to schedule her
debut race,
we focused on reasonable,
fundamentals-oriented training.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's wrap it up here for...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thank you for the hard work~!
...Trainer, how did my running look today?
choice_data_list: You've grown even more since the M...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after signing our contract,
she continued to work just as hard.
Her positive attitude was truly
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, regarding after this...
Would it be alright if I did just a little
self-training?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to review today's session on my
own.
So that next time,
I can truly take center stage...!
choice_data_list: Go ahead. Just make sure not to ov...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Well then, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At this rate,
she should be able to make her debut without
an issue.
Dantsu Flame must be burning with drive for
the real race ahead, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Everything is going smoothly.
Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Hey,
did you see the mock race schedule updated
this morning?
Everyone's buzzing about how interesting
one of the races is gonna be.
choice_data_list: No, I haven't checked it yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Look,
right here.
Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket!
The top two contenders among those close to
debuting are both running in it.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even the veteran trainers are keeping a
close eye on it, saying it might
foretell the future of the racing
world...!
choice_data_list: A race like that's—... Wait, what...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the list of prospective entrants
handed to me
by my colleague,
I am rendered completely speechless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For some reason, Dantsu Flame's name
was unmistakably written right there.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm... Looking at it like this,
my core really is wavering...
...Ah, Trainer! Good work today!
choice_data_list: Dantsu, what in the world is this—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, the mock race!
Oh, right,
they put your name down just for requesting
an entry...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
I actually planned on checking with you
about this today, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
But they said entries would close quickly
if you didn't apply early,
so I panicked and put my name in...
I did things in reverse order, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is currently under contract with me.
In other words,
all the prerequisites for her debut have
already been met.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore,
fine-tuning for her official debut should
be top priority. Frankly speaking,
running in this mock race serves almost no
purpose...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I just thought this would be my chance to
prove
that I can truly be a "leading lady"...
choice_data_list: Prove that you're a... leading lady?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
Tachyon-chan and Pokke-chan are already such
incredible horsegirls,
acting like true "leading ladies" even before
debuting...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me,
they're overflowing with raw talent and
clutch power...!
They have this aura that makes everyone feel
they're in a league of their own...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This is a precious chance to compete against
both of them at once.
If I can fight them here...
If I can win...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Then surely I can aim to be a "leading lady"
too...!
I think I can prove that it's okay for me
to make my debut!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...A sharp sense of dissonance. Along with it,
a creeping anxiety.
A rising impatience urges me to find the
true source of this feeling.
choice_data_list: Um... There's one thing I'd like t...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes? What is it?
choice_data_list: Do you feel it's still too early f...
Do you feel it's still too early f...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yes.
Because, well—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win,
did I? In the selection race.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, I have to prove that I'm someone
capable of going toe-to-toe with Pokke-chan
and the others!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Dantsu Flame's gaze is so painfully
earnest.
Her feelings,
her words—
there is not an ounce of doubt in them.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Was it really bad that I applied first
without asking...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice, standing right before my eyes,
sounds distant.
...Or perhaps,
she was never truly close to me from the
beginning—
choice_data_list: ——... Could you give me some time ...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right... Of course.
I'm sorry for dropping this on you so
suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...A horsegirl worthy of being a "leading
lady" wouldn't lose in a selection race.
I still...
haven't shown that I can be a "leading lady"
yet.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I truly intend to race to win against
Pokke-chan and the others, for real!
So please, won't you consider it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu Flame's joyful smile is a familiar
sight. And yet,
what she harbors deep within her right now...
I likely know nothing about.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It might be a little sudden,
but can I go do some extra training after
this?
I want to do everything I can,
starting right now...!
choice_data_list: All right. Just don't overdo it.
All right. Just don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm off!
—...Thank you so much for listening to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Later that night.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *gasp*...——
Alright... Just one more set...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I have to push myself... even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Curious about Dantsu Flame's independent
training, I watched her
secretly from afar afterwards.
What I saw left me stunned.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The volume and intensity of her self-imposed
training far exceeded imagination.
To think she had been doing this on top of
her regular regimen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The look on her face is desperate. Truly,
purely desperate to get stronger.
Her fierce determination radiates clearly,
even from a distance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since the selection race until today,
she has been agonizing over it.
She even believed that 'there's no way I
deserve to debut like this.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why she pushed herself relentlessly,
piling on every bit of effort she could.
And despite all that, I—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I must learn once again.
The inner feelings harbored by the horsegirl
I'm meant to support. What they truly are—
